{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ailon Marshallate''' was the commanding body of the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]], led by the [[High Marshall of Ailon]]. In the post-[[Endor/Legends|Endor]] period, the Ailon Marshallate switched allegiances from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] when it became clear the Empire was losing the war, and how their [[Speciesism|racist]] agenda kept the [[Ailon (species)/Legends|Ailon]] from being deployed in the war.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref>
